summary: Nasus Pharma filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of CFO Eyal Rubin, effective September 18, 2026, to pursue an opportunity outside life sciences. The departure is not due to any disagreement. Oren Elmaliach, Director of Finance, was appointed interim CFO until a successor is named. The filing includes a press release and is incorporated by reference into the company's Form S-8. This is a routine executive transition, not a forced departure, but the resignation is the sole event. The company continues operations with CEO Brendan O'Grady and Chairman Udi Gilboa expressing support. There are no deal terms or strategic actions; watch for the appointment of a permanent CFO and any operational impacts.
